brief: A caddy that holds two jerry cans of petrol upright in the boot of my car.

requirements.requirement: Caddy that holds two jerry cans upright
requirements.evidence: 2×2 grid of full hex cells (piece:0,0,0; piece:1,0,0; piece:0,1,0; piece:1,1,0) stacked 2 storeys (level 1 pieces added) gives four open-top wells ~160mm deep with walls on all sides. Each full cell bin envelope is ~177x153mm, sized to contain a standard ~20L jerry can upright and prevent tipping/sliding. Two cans fit side-by-side using two of the four wells.

requirements.requirement: Fits in the boot of a car
requirements.evidence: Build footprint ~ 2 cells wide, 2 storeys high (320mm tall total with 80mm bases). Compact modular block with no protruding handles, caps on perimeter, joint-locked. Can be lifted in/out of boot as one caddy.

requirements.requirement: Safe for petrol containment / automotive fuel use
requirements.evidence: Configurator verifies geometry/collision only (check_build clear). All parts are 3D-printed in user-chosen material; no fuel-chemical resistance, vapour sealing, flame/heat resistance, crash load rating, or spill containment is verified by the system. Cannot claim petrol-safe - user must ensure regulations and use proper certified cans.

finish.summary: Built 4-cell (2x2) two-storey open-top caddy providing four walled wells sized for upright jerry cans; two cans sit upright in adjacent wells and are braced against tipping in a boot. Geometry verified (meshClash clear, joints locked). Petrol/flammables safety, material chemical resistance and automotive crash retention cannot be verified by Hex Cluster and are marked unmet.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
**Build:** 4-cell rectangular carrier (2×2 hexes) stacked 2 storeys high ≈160 mm deep wells with open tops. Each cell is an upright well sized to take a standard ~20 L jerry can upright; the four surrounding walls prevent tipping/sliding in a car boot. Joint bolts + caps applied.

View from above shows 4 distinct upright compartments.

Check_build: ok / meshClash clear.

Honest assessment - petrol / boot use is outside what Hex Cluster + 3D-printed plastic can certify:
